plugins.name: openscience
plugins.description: Open science toolkit — OpenAIRE Research Graph (600M+ products, citations, authors, projects) and bioRxiv/medRxiv preprint data clusters

plugins.name: platform-basics
plugins.description: Operate the Alien platform control-plane: orientation, document ingestion, wrapping an external API as MCP tools, publishing/sharing MCP configs, RBAC and pricing, analytics, and cleanup.

plugins.name: workflow-engine
plugins.description: Build and run agentic workflows on Alien: the node/DAG model, the agent-building loop (tools, MCP servers, subagents), model selection, and execution via the OpenAI Responses API.

plugins.name: mcp-tool-refinement
plugins.description: Refine the MCP tools Alien generates from an external API's OpenAPI spec so agents call them correctly — the concept, the safety rules, and a build-your-own refinement-agent recipe.

plugins.name: recipes
plugins.description: End-to-end cookbook chaining the atomic Alien tools into outcomes: RAG agent over documents, external API to agent, publish-and-share a source, multi-source research agent.

plugins.name: troubleshooting
plugins.description: Diagnose and fix common Alien platform failures via the MCP: worker_disconnected, permission gaps, stuck ingestion, gateway timeouts, and invalid model slugs.
